rationale: Price is sitting near the midpoint of today's range (47.6%) with no clear directional momentum — the last two 1-minute candles show a wide-range opening bar followed by a lower close, suggesting indecision rather than a clean trend. The 9-EMA ($154.03) is well above the current price ($152.68) and VWAP ($152.73), indicating short-term downward pressure, but the gap-down open on positive news creates a conflicting signal where sellers may be exhausted or buyers may step in. With spread and liquidity acceptable but no structural level being tested cleanly, the risk/reward for either direction lacks sufficient definition to justify entry.
